_note: Proposed SharePoint lists for HomeBridge internal review cases. Not yet provisioned. Holds no credentials.

lists.title: HomeBridge Review Cases
lists.purpose: One internal review case per case_key. A case authorises no customer contact, rate or credit decision (INV-6).
lists.write_access: The flow identity can add and edit items. Advisers can edit reviewer_decision only. No one can delete items.

columns.name: assigned_to
columns.description: Owner ID or queue name. Payment support goes to trained servicing staff.

columns.name: evidence_ids
columns.description: JSON array of evidence references. No borrower notes.

columns.name: store
columns.description: Always 'sharepoint' in this list. The local reference writes 'local'.

lists.title: HomeBridge Review Case Audit
lists.purpose: Append-only audit log. One row per routing decision and per case action.
lists.write_access: The flow identity can add items only. No one can edit or delete items.

columns.name: details
columns.description: JSON. Evidence IDs, model and run references, times. No borrower notes.

lists.title: HomeBridge Routing Exceptions
lists.purpose: Exception register: quarantine, held reviews and failed writes. An operator reads this list.
lists.write_access: The flow identity can add items. Operators can edit resolution fields.
